name: Hunan Er-Kang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd
summary: Hunan Er-Kang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical excipients, APIs and finished drugs in China and internationally. The company offers various APIs, such as glycerin, dilute hydrochloric acid, dihydroxypropyl theophylline, sulbenicillin sodium, dihydroxypropyl theophylline, calamine powder, sulfadiazine, sulphaguanidine, TMP, and resorcinol. It also provides finished drugs, including sulbenicillin sodium for injection and compound liquorice tablets. In addition, the company offers conventional pharmaceutical excipients, such as pharmaceutical glycerin, medicinal ethanol, medicinal propylene glycol, medicinal sodium hydroxide…
